name: provider-switcher
description: Switch the Claude Code chat panel and the Codex extension between AI provider and model presets, with DeepSeek included.

commands.title: Provider Switcher: Reset Preset API Key
Provider Switcher: Reset Codex API Key

providerSwitcher.presets.markdownDescription: Presets for both targets, edited in User Settings JSON. `claude` holds the provider presets offered by the Claude Code status bar button; `codex` holds the model presets offered by the Codex button. Built-in DeepSeek presets merge with your overrides; set one to `null` to hide it. New IDs add presets. One key is stored per endpoint host and reused by every preset that uses it, on both sides. After editing, select the preset again and reload the window.

label.description: Name shown in the preset picker and status bar.

apiKeyEnv.description: Variable receiving the separately stored API key. Use none for an endpoint that needs no key.

environment.description: Environment variables for this preset. ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is required for new presets. Values are strings; null removes an inherited value. Do not put credentials here. Cloud-provider routing flags must remain 0.

codex.description: Model presets for the Codex extension. Selecting one rewrites ~/.codex/config.toml, keeping unrelated settings such as projects and MCP servers.

label.description: Name shown in the picker and status bar.

model.description: Model name sent to the endpoint, for example deepseek-flash.

provider.description: Identifier of the [model_providers.<id>] table written to the configuration.

baseUrl.markdownDescription: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Must not contain credentials, a query, or a fragment.

wireApi.description: Protocol used to talk to the endpoint.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort requested from the model.

apiKey.description: Whether the endpoint needs an API key. Use false for a local endpoint that accepts none.

providerSwitcher.statusBarColors.markdownDescription: Status bar text and icon colors by preset ID. Use `claude` for the restored Claude Code configuration, `chatgpt` for the restored Codex configuration, and `custom` for an unmatched provider. Values are six-digit hex colors or `null` to use the VS Code theme color. Changes apply immediately.

providerSwitcher.statusBarAlignment.description: Position of the status bar item

scripts.lint: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/deepseek-rate.js && node --check src/presets.js && node --check src/codex-config.js

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Provider switching changes the Claude Code extension's credentials and connection settings, and the extension keeps a copy of the Codex configuration file next to it.
